howItWorks.title: From Topic to Learning Experience
howItWorks.step1Desc: Choose a topic or enter your own. The platform understands the subject and creates a structured lesson outline instantly.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The system turns the outline into a complete lesson with explanations, examples, and practice — ready to use or edit.
howItWorks.feature1Desc: Videos, simulations, quizzes, and activities that keep lessons engaging.
howItWorks.feature2Desc: Share, discover, and adapt lessons from the community.
howItWorks.feature3Desc: Aligned with curriculum standards and trusted educational sources.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about BilimAI.
faq.a1: BilimAI is an AI-powered educational platform that helps teachers create structured lessons and provides students with personalized learning tools.
faq.a2: No. BilimAI is designed to empower teachers, not replace them. It automates lesson preparation so teachers can focus on what matters most — teaching and connecting with students.
faq.q3: Can teachers create lessons outside the curriculum?
faq.a3: Yes. While the platform supports curriculum-aligned content, teachers are free to create lessons on any topic they choose.
faq.q4: What does an AI-generated lesson include?
faq.a4: Each lesson includes structured explanations, examples, practice questions, and optional interactive elements like quizzes and activities.
faq.q5: Will teachers be able to share lessons?
faq.a5: Yes. The upcoming Lesson Marketplace will allow teachers to share, discover, and adapt lessons created by the community.
faq.a6: The platform is currently in development. Stay tuned for updates on our launch date.
